mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM user_realname_verification WHERE user_id=#{user} AND verification_status='verified') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM user_student_verification WHERE user_id=#{user} AND verification_status='approved' AND expire_at>#{at})
mapper.sql: FROM coupon_distribution a JOIN coupon_template t ON t.id=a.template_id WHERE a.status='active' AND a.mode='conditional_claim' AND a.starts_at<=#{at} AND a.ends_at>#{at} AND t.template_status='active' AND (t.valid_end_at IS NULL OR t.valid_end_at>#{at}) AND (a.config_json->>'$.condition'='all_active' OR (#{student} AND a.config_json->>'$.condition'='student_verified')) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_coupon c WHERE c.issue_request_id=CONCAT('claim:',a.id,':user:',#{user}))
mapper.select: SELECT a.id AS activity_id,t.id AS template_id,t.template_name,t.coupon_type,t.face_amount_fen,t.discount_rate_bps, t.threshold_rent_amount_fen,t.applicable_scope_type,a.config_json->>'$.condition' AS condition_code,a.ends_at, t.validity_type,t.valid_days,t.valid_start_at,t.valid_end_at ORDER BY a.ends_at,a.id LIMIT #{page.pageSize} OFFSET #{pageOffset}

SELECT s.coupon_template_id AS template_id,f.id AS factory_id,f.factory_name FROM coupon_scope_target s JOIN factory_profile f ON f.id=s.target_id WHERE s.scope_type='factory' AND s.coupon_template_id IN #{id} ORDER BY s.coupon_template_id,f.id
SELECT id,template_id,config_json->>'$.condition' AS condition_code,status,starts_at,ends_at FROM coupon_distribution WHERE id=#{id} AND mode='conditional_claim' FOR UPDATE

SELECT id,template_name,coupon_type,face_amount_fen,discount_rate_bps,threshold_rent_amount_fen,cost_bearer, applicable_scope_type,validity_type,valid_days,valid_start_at,valid_end_at,template_status FROM coupon_template WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT id AS user_coupon_id,IF(coupon_status IN ('available','returned') AND valid_until<=#{at},'expired',coupon_status) AS coupon_status, TRUE AS already_claimed FROM user_coupon WHERE issue_request_id=#{key} AND user_id=#{user}
mapper.update: UPDATE coupon_distribution SET issued_quantity=issued_quantity+1 WHERE id=#{id}
